summary: The stadium was rebuilt in 2024-25; no elevated interior photo of the renovated stadium is on Commons yet. The only current-form image is a high oblique drone aerial (marked last resort).

files.author: Kuwxman
files.credit_line: Photo: Kuwxman, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons
files.note: LAST RESORT - high oblique drone aerial (not a stands view) of the renovated stadium, Aug 2025, empty, no crowd: new north end zone and west stands with field in rows ~160-830 of 1350 (12-60%), lawn, exterior and practice field fill the lower half

closest_misses.why: Elevated interior from the press box, but taken Nov 2023 a week before demolition: pre-renovation stadium, no longer its current form
